_note: LLMJobs configuration of ChatSOP (LLMJobs/README.md; found by `node LLMJobs/run.mjs jobs/<job>` as the nearest llmjobs.config.json). Jobs and the runner name only model tiers, never concrete models (owner, 2026-10-02), so a proxy configuration change needs no job change. Proxy tiers (owner, corrected 2026-10-02): tiny = local Qwen3-4B, small = openference Qwen3.8 27b, medium = deepseek-v4-flash, good = deepseek-v4.1-flash, best = not configured (not used). Roles: planner and decider = good, auditor = medium, worker = small, worker-short = tiny. When the proxy serves a tier (GET /health lists it under `tiers`), the runner calls the tier by name through the proxy; until then `fallback` gives the concrete chain of each tier.

fallback._note: Concrete chains per tier while the proxy has no tiers. good = deepseek-v4.1-flash with low reasoning (decent at code, still cheap); medium = deepseek-v4-flash with low reasoning (as auditor, calibration-v1: 10/10 planted errors, 0/20 false alarms); small = the openference plan's Qwen3.8 27b, then deepseek-v4-flash when the plan is unavailable; tiny = the local Qwen3-4B. best is not configured.

limits._note: Upper bounds a planned task may request; a plan above them is refused before any work call.
